name: OpenAI Computer Use Sample Apps
description: OpenAI's sample computer-use agents: one drives a browser with Playwright code, another a desktop via PyAutoGUI.
whatItDoes: The repo shows how to build agents that operate software to finish a task, with a shared web console and practice labs (kanban board, paint canvas, booking site). It is for developers learning OpenAI's computer-use pattern.
howItWorks: The model writes code that runs in a persistent runtime: JavaScript with Playwright for the browser agent, Python with PyAutoGUI for the desktop agent. A Responses API loop feeds results and screenshots back to the model.
models: OpenAI models via the Responses API
